youtube_description: After conducting the first Women's Artistic Gymnastics (WAG) Senior and Junior National Camp since being appointed as Australia's new WAG National Coach, Mihai Brestyan talked to Gymnastics Australia about his time at the Australian Institute of Sport in Canberra.
youtube_title: Interview with Mihai Brestyan following WAG National Camp (April 2017)
